provenance.method: Visible unmodified browser binaries, fresh isolated profiles and ordinary HTTPS Alt-Svc discovery. Controlled namespace redirects UDP/443 to an alternate QUIC peer and delays outbound TCP/443 by 750 ms. No forced QUIC, resolver override, UA override or certificate-verification bypass. HRR is requested by server P-384 preference. Native handshake proceeds through the captured Initial exchange and then correctly rejects the alternate peer certificate. This is not an accepted native HTTP/3 connection reference.
provenance.firefox_platform: Official Linux aarch64 Firefox 160.0; visible Xvfb; native arm64 execution.
provenance.chromium_platform: Official Linux_x64 snapshot 1727495, Chromium 158.0.8127.0; visible Xvfb under amd64 emulation; no-sandbox is required inside the disposable container and does not bypass TLS verification.
provenance.chromium_origins: Captured Chromium background www.google.com connections use the same default QUIC policy; they are not represented as fp.impersonate.pro navigations.
provenance.analysis: Exact UDP datagrams logged at the controlled socket preserve segmentation independently of GSO. RFC Initial decryption and Wireshark packet/frame decoding are compared. Original NIC captures and socket logs remain private; synthetic analysis IP/UDP envelopes are not timing or OS packet-layout oracles.
